name: Bone Runners VR
summary:
Bone Runners is a game that uses Gorilla Tag Locomotions to create its own Fun experience!

You can do so much in this game including playing tag, getting chased by Nextbots, Buying and Wearing Cosmetics and much much more!

it is a very fun experience and if you like Gtag fangame or Gorilla Tag, this game is a must have!
